authority.methodology: AI-Assisted Software Engineering Governance Standard v1.0
contracts: G4-07 Source Authorization and Bounds Rev 0.1, SRC-17
G4-02/06 Source Evidence Map Rev 0.1 SRC-17
Approved G5-03 original passive worker source enumerator

scope.explicit_prohibition: No /dev/sr* reads, no media access or media-verified inference, no writes or sudo

path_contract.order: successful device dirs in sorted(os.listdir(root)) lexical order; within each srN directory use exact worker tuple attribute order; only successfully sealed item paths appear in receipt source_paths, and item0001... refer to those paths in the same sequence
path_contract.identity: Private optical.sysfs.<srN>.<attribute components>, from validated receipt path only, never from text bytes
path_contract.forbidden: unsupported attributes, unknown directory name, ambiguous duplicate, traversal, non-lexical order, truncated path, forged cross-run pointer

type_oracles.device/type: nonnegative decimal integer SCSI peripheral type code only; do not convert type to claims about inserted media
type_oracles.device/vendor: bounded single-line UTF-8 text, preserved verbatim original and normalized trimmed string
type_oracles.device/model: bounded single-line UTF-8 text, preserved verbatim original and normalized trimmed string

cases.input: sr0 removable, device/type, vendor, model in fixed G5 worker order
cases.expected: Four original and four corresponding typed records tied to matching sealed bytes and same-run attempts, status COMPLETE/OK if parser ran and all values valid

cases.input: sr10 and sr2 paths with lexical ordering, optional fields skipped
cases.expected: Do not sort numerically; preserve matching device identity and field provenance

cases.input: source absent or optional model unavailable
cases.expected: Do not synthesize an optical device or model/media; existing absent-source state remains authoritative

cases.input: receipt path count differs from sealed items or item ordinal corrupted
attribute order swapped, duplicate path, device name order swapped
cases.expected: reject ambiguity even if byte data appear valid

cases.input: wrong root, /dev/sr0, srX, unauthorized device/serial, traversal, extra path segments
wrong run evidence ID, source owner mismatched, changed sealed original
malformed device/type, invalid boolean, embedded NUL, invalid UTF8 or multiline
cases.expected: record true parser failure with lossless raw fallback; do not label unsupported parser as failed

cases.input: type code 5 or unusual nonnegative code; no successful media read
cases.expected: record numeric code only, never media_verified
value can remain empty without invented product identity; preserve original bytes

review.method: Separate contract-source-first reasoning before parser edits
review.independence_limitation: Same AI agent; no independent human or separately briefed agent judgment
review.no_gate_acceptance: CI fixture pass cannot close CP-03 or G5-04

scope_boundaries: Candidate C single acquisition engine unchanged
No public report output or raw-source pointers
No schema, privilege or external behavior revision
